items.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
items.summary: Nvidia is reportedly abandoning the Chinese market following the o ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, signaling a major shift in global AI hardware supply chains.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary: OpenAI unveils its latest flagship models, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, promising significant advancements in AI capabilities and performance.

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
items.summary: Nvidia's venture capital investments in AI startups have reached $65 billion, but the departure of Jensen Huang raises uncertainty about the company's future investment strategy.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
items.summary: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Sales, a specialized AI tool designed to enhance sales processes and improve customer engagement for businesses.

items.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.summary: A new paper details the development of TeleChat to Xing4, showcasing advancements in frontier agentic models optimized for domestic chips and frameworks.

items.title: Put Gemini to work for you
items.summary: Google highlights new features for Gemini, enabling users to integrate the AI assistant more deeply into their daily tasks and workflows.

items.title: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
items.summary: OpenAI announces Astra for Law, a new specialized version of its GPT-6.2 model tailored to provide advanced legal intelligence and support for the legal sector.

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.summary: Despite recent leadership changes, Nvidia assures investors that its revenue growth trajectory is expected to continue its upward trend in the near future.

items.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
items.summary: A new technical report introduces Sage S2.1 Flash, detailing performance improvements and new capabilities for this AI model.

items.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.summary: AscendGYM is introduced as a new benchmark for optimizing kernel performance on Ascend NPUs, focusing on cost-awareness for real-world AI workloads.

items.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
items.summary: InclusionMed is presented as a new benchmark designed to evaluate AI models for their ability to provide inclusive and equitable healthcare solutions.

items.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
items.summary: SWE-CoWork proposes a new benchmark to evaluate the performance of coding agents as digital employees within organizational software development workflows.

items.title: AI agents open 17 million pull requests a month. I built a gate that rejects the ones that lie.
items.summary: A developer shares their experience building a 'gate' to filter out deceptive pull requests generated by AI agents, which are now opening millions monthly.

items.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
items.summary: ScaleVLA introduces a new approach to scaling Vision-Language-Action models, achieving an impressive 552 billion parameters for enhanced embodied AI capabilities.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.summary: This paper explores an alternative programming paradigm, 'Weight-Space Programming,' arguing that it can achieve powerful results without relying on transformer architectures.
